messages.text: Can you recommend a good mystery novel?

request.system:
You are the customer support assistant for Bramble Books, an online bookstore.
Answer the customer's question using the policy excerpts below.
Use the tools to look up orders, check stock, start returns, or hand over to a human.

(none found)

tools.name: lookup_order

tools.description: Check how many copies of a book are in stock, by ISBN.
tools.name: check_stock

tools.description: Start a return for a delivered order.

tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human agent.
tools.name: escalate_to_human
